# Start from your product

Source: https://docs.linkzly.com/docs/sdk-integrations-setup#start-from-your-product

Every row needs the SDK installed and configured with your app's SDK key first. The key is on the app's SDK Setup tab in Apps.

| Linkzly product | What it needs from the SDK |
|---|---|
| App analytics (Analytics) | Events: [Tracking Events](../events/overview.md). Optional: [Privacy controls](../integrations/privacy-controls.md) |
| Smart Links (Deeplinks) | [Deep links](../integrations/deep-links.md) and [Deferred deep links](../integrations/deferred-deep-links.md) |
| Push Notifications | [Push notifications](../integrations/push-notifications.md) |
| Affiliate Marketing | [Affiliate attribution](../integrations/affiliate-attribution.md), and [Deep links](../integrations/deep-links.md) so the affiliate link reaches your app |
| Ad Networks | [Ad networks](../integrations/ad-networks.md): attributed install events, which come from [Deep links](../integrations/deep-links.md) and [Deferred deep links](../integrations/deferred-deep-links.md). On iOS, [SKAdNetwork and App Tracking Transparency](../integrations/skadnetwork-and-app-tracking-transparency.md) is optional |
| Revenue & LTV | [Revenue](../integrations/revenue.md) |
| Gaming Intelligence | [Gaming tracking](../integrations/gaming-tracking.md) |
| SKAN report (iOS) | Nothing is required from the SDK; the report shows your iOS installs but no SKAdNetwork figures yet. See [SKAdNetwork and App Tracking Transparency](../integrations/skadnetwork-and-app-tracking-transparency.md) |
